test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 26 Jul 2023 Shift 4)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 3.
solution:
The correct answer is: **until.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"until"** is used to indicate the time at which the event (only being able to see the top of the ship) will stop happening.
 
• "Until" is a conjunction that's often used to show the continuance of an action up to a certain point.
 
• It sets a limit in time, after which the next part of the sentence ("then we see nothing at all") takes place.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Until**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• "After" would not make sense in this context, as it indicates something happening subsequent to an event, but does not convey the continuity up to a specific point.
 
• "Up to" could potentially be used, but it is less common in this context and does not convey the sense of a continuous event as clearly as "until."
 
• "Since" is used to indicate the start of a period up to the present and does not fit here, as we're discussing a future event.
